meta.name: 学术英语改写范式库（Before → After）
meta.purpose: 针对中式英语与 AI 腔问题，给出可模仿的改写示例与手法说明
meta.positioning: 写作辅导工具（示范改写思路，帮助学生自己改），非代写

examples.before: In my opinion, I think that online learning is very very good for students.
examples.after: Online learning benefits students in several concrete ways.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 删除冗余
examples.note: 删去观点引导词叠加与 very very，把笼统评价转为可展开的论点句，便于后续给出具体理由

examples.before: With the rapid development of society, more and more people pay attention to mental health.
examples.after: Public concern with mental health has grown sharply since 2015, when Malaysia's national health survey first reported a rise in diagnosed anxiety.
examples.technique: 增加具体性 + 去套话
examples.note: 以具体时间、事件和数据替换『随着……发展』『越来越』等模板开头

examples.before: Although the theory is old, but it is still useful for us.
examples.after: Although the theory is dated, it still offers a useful analytical lens.
examples.technique: 精确化用词 + 删除冗余
examples.note: 修正 although/but 同现错误；old/useful for us 改为更精确的 dated / analytical lens

examples.before: The research was done by our group, and we found that the result is very important.
examples.after: Our group's study found the result to be significant.
examples.technique: 主动化 + 合并碎句 + 精确化用词
examples.note: 删去无必要被动 was done by，合并两个分句；important 在统计语境应为 significant

examples.before: Firstly, the cost is high. Secondly, the quality is not good. Thirdly, the service is slow.
examples.after: Three linked problems undermine the service: high cost, poor quality and slow response.
examples.technique: 合并碎句 + 调整语序
examples.note: 将机械清单合并为主题句 + 并列，把序数连接词换成逻辑关系，节奏更自然

examples.before: It is important to note that the implementation of the optimization of the system is necessary.
examples.after: The system needs to be optimized.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 去名词化
examples.note: 删去元话语引导语，拆解 implementation/optimization 名词化堆叠，还原动词

examples.before: This paper will delve into the multifaceted nature of the intricate interplay between AI and education.
examples.after: This paper examines how AI tools affect classroom assessment in Malaysian secondary schools.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性
examples.note: 删去 delve into / multifaceted / intricate interplay 等 AI 腔抽象词，明确研究对象与范围

examples.before: Technology plays a crucial role in modern society.
examples.after: Digital payments now handle 60% of retail transactions in urban Malaysia.
examples.technique: 增加具体性 + 去套话
examples.note: 把 plays a crucial role 这一空洞论断替换为可核验的具体事实

examples.before: In today's fast-paced world, students need to learn knowledge quickly. Moreover, they should also develop skills. Furthermore, they must adapt to change.
examples.after: Students today must acquire knowledge rapidly and keep adapting as conditions shift.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句 + 变换句式节奏
examples.note: 删去 fast-paced world 开头与 Moreover/Furthermore 堆叠，合并三句为一，长句承载递进

examples.before: It is widely believed that exercise is good for health. Everyone knows that.
examples.after: Regular exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease (WHO, 2020).
examples.technique: 补充论证 + 去套话
examples.note: 把诉诸常识的断言改为带引用的具体结论

examples.before: I think maybe probably the government should do something to solve this problem.
examples.after: The government could address the problem by tightening emission standards.
examples.technique: 加入限定语 + 补充论证
examples.note: 删去情态词叠加，把『做点什么』具体化为可操作的举措，同时保留 could 的审慎语气

examples.before: The company should be responsible for the pollution. They must be punished.
examples.after: Because the company knowingly discharged waste, it bears legal responsibility for the resulting pollution.
examples.technique: 补充论证 + 精确化用词
examples.note: 补上因果前提，把价值判断转为有依据的推论；punished 改为更中性的 legal responsibility

examples.before: There is a growing tendency for the majority of the students to use social media every day.
examples.after: Most students now use social media daily.
examples.technique: 去名词化 + 删除冗余
examples.note: there be + 抽象名词结构改为直陈主谓，信息量不变而更简洁

examples.before: We need to make an investigation of the causes and conduct an analysis of the data.
examples.after: We investigated the causes and analysed the data.
examples.technique: 去名词化 + 精确化用词
examples.note: 拆解轻动词 + 名词化结构，还原为单一动词

examples.before: As we all know, education is very important for a country's development.
examples.after: Education strongly predicts a country's long-run economic growth (Hanushek & Woessmann, 2015).
examples.technique: 去套话 + 补充论证 + 增加具体性
examples.note: 删去 As we all know，把空泛断言转为可引用的实证结论

examples.before: The problem is very serious. It affects many people. It needs to be solved as soon as possible.
examples.after: The problem affects millions and demands urgent attention.
examples.technique: 合并碎句 + 变换句式节奏 + 精确化用词
examples.note: 三句短句合并为一句，用 demands urgent attention 收束，避免同构短句堆叠

examples.before: In conclusion, in a nutshell, to sum up, AI is important for education.
examples.after: Overall, AI is reshaping how students are assessed.
examples.technique: 删除冗余 + 去套话 + 增加具体性
examples.note: 删去重复收束语，只保留一个，并把 important 落到具体作用上

examples.before: On the one hand, AI saves time. On the other hand, AI saves money.
examples.after: AI cuts both time and cost.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句
examples.note: 两点并非对立，不应套用 on one hand/on the other hand 平衡句式

examples.before: The reason is because the data was not collected properly.
examples.after: The problem arose because the data were collected inconsistently.
examples.technique: 删除冗余 + 精确化用词 + 主动化
examples.note: 修正 reason/because 重复，data 复数一致，not properly 改为更具体的 inconsistently

examples.before: He didn't went to the library yesterday because he must prepare for the exam.
examples.after: He did not go to the library yesterday because he had to prepare for the exam.
examples.technique: 精确化用词
examples.note: 修正 didn't went 时态错误；过去语境中 must 应改为 had to

examples.before: In recent years, with the development of the Internet, online shopping has become more and more popular among the young people.
examples.after: Online shopping has grown fastest among young adults since 2018.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 变换句式节奏
examples.note: 删去双重套话开头与 more and more，用具体群体与时间替代

examples.before: The essay will discuss about the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. It is worth noting that this is a hot topic.
examples.after: This essay weighs the benefits of remote work against its costs.
examples.technique: 拆分长句 + 去套话 + 精确化用词
examples.note: 修正 discuss about 搭配错误，删去 It is worth noting 元话语与 hot topic 空话

examples.before: This is not just about saving money, it's about saving the environment.
examples.after: The policy reduces both household costs and carbon emissions.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性
examples.note: 删去 not just about... it's about 模板句式，直接列出两个具体效果

examples.before: A myriad of studies have shed light on the importance of sleep.
examples.after: Numerous studies have linked poor sleep to reduced academic performance.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 精确化用词
examples.note: a myriad of 改为 numerous；shed light on the importance 改为具体因果结论

examples.before: As a student, we should study hard to get a bright future.
examples.after: As students, we study hard partly because it widens our career options.
examples.technique: 调整语序 + 补充论证
examples.note: 修正主谓人称不一致；get a bright future 改为可论证的具体理由

examples.before: The implementation of the new policy has caused a significant reduction in the number of accidents.
examples.after: The new policy has significantly reduced accidents.
examples.technique: 去名词化 + 精确化用词
examples.note: implementation/has caused a reduction 名词化链缩短，还原为动词 reduced

examples.before: Nowadays, many people think that the education system should be changed. I agree with it.
examples.after: Public opinion increasingly favours reforming the education system.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句 + 精确化用词
examples.note: 删去 Nowadays 与 I agree with it 这类表态句，把观点融进主句

examples.before: The data shows that the result is statistically significant, and it proves our hypothesis is correct.
examples.after: The data indicate a statistically significant result, which supports our hypothesis.
examples.technique: 精确化用词 + 加入限定语
examples.note: data 复数一致；proves 过强，改为 supports；避免宣称『证明』

examples.before: In order to better understand the problem, it is important to note that we need more research.
examples.after: Understanding the problem requires further research into its causes.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句
examples.note: 删去 In order to better understand 与 It is important to note 双重填充，压缩为一句

examples.before: The ever-evolving landscape of technology has transformed the way we live and work in today's digital age.
examples.after: Mobile computing has changed how Malaysians shop, study and bank.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 变换句式节奏
examples.note: 删去 ever-evolving landscape / digital age，落到具体技术、地域与活动，句子由抽象变具体

examples.before: The theory which is proposed by Zhang is very useful for us to solve this problem.
examples.after: Zhang's theory offers a workable solution to the problem.
examples.technique: 拆分长句 + 精确化用词 + 删除冗余
examples.note: which is proposed by 改为所有格；very useful for us to 改为 workable，结构紧凑

examples.before: Many researches show that feedback is good for learning, but some researches disagree.
examples.after: Most studies find that feedback improves learning, although findings on its timing remain mixed.
examples.technique: 精确化用词 + 加入限定语
examples.note: researches 改为 studies；笼统的 some disagree 改为有分歧点的具体限定

examples.before: It is undeniable that climate change is a serious problem that we must face together.
examples.after: Malaysia's mean temperature has risen about 0.9°C since 1970, intensifying flood risk along the east coast.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性
examples.note: 删去 It is undeniable that 与 we must face together 空话，用具体数据与后果替代

examples.before: The study of the cultural influence on consumer behavior was carried out by the researcher, and the result obtained shows that culture has an important effect.
examples.after: The study shows that culture strongly shapes consumer behaviour.
examples.technique: 主动化 + 去名词化 + 合并碎句
examples.note: 删去 was carried out by / the result obtained，合并为一句；an important effect 改为 strongly shapes

examples.before: Last but not least, I want to say that protecting the environment is good. In a word, we should protect it.
examples.after: Protecting the environment ultimately benefits both public health and the economy.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 删除冗余 + 增加具体性
examples.note: 删去 Last but not least / I want to say / In a word，把 good 落到具体受益面

examples.before: With the development of the economy, the living standard of people becomes higher and higher, and this phenomenon is very significant in the society.
examples.after: Rising incomes have steadily improved living standards across Malaysian cities.
examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句 + 精确化用词 + 变换句式节奏
examples.note: 删去套话开头与 higher and higher；多个分句合并为一句，避免『现象很显著』这类自证式收尾
